title: Winter Embrace
coreRelationships: The two figures are central, partially obscured by snow, and appear to be embracing, creating a focal point of human connection amidst a harsh environment.
The two skyscrapers frame the figures, providing a towering, architectural backdrop that emphasizes the urban and cold setting.
The stark contrast between the bright white snow and the dark, stormy night sky with falling snow creates a dramatic and moody atmosphere.
The glowing red tops of the skyscrapers provide a strong, contrasting accent color against the otherwise cool and dark palette.
reuseFormula: Recreate a dramatic, high-contrast night scene featuring two figures in fur coats embracing in a snowdrift, framed by two tall, twisting skyscrapers with glowing red tops, under falling snow. Overlay a black 'Parental Advisory' badge in the bottom-left.
